people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
